data.long_meaning: The name Ku is derived from the Sanskrit language and holds great significance in Hindu mythology. It is a unisex name and is considered a form of Lord Shiva. Ku is believed to represent the creative and destructive aspects of the universe, symbolizing transformation and regeneration. The name Ku is also believed to bring good luck and prosperity.

historical_references.reference: Ku was an ancient Hindu goddess of the sun and the earth, worshipped primarily in the regions of modern Maharashtra and Karnataka. She was considered the goddess of fertility and the protector of rice fields and crops.

In later Hindu mythology, Ku became identified with the goddess Kali, who was originally a goddess of time and destruction. Ku was believed to be an aspect of Kali, representing her benevolent and nurturing side that protected and cared for her devotees.
